branchSelectionContract.rule: Use each workstream activeDevelopment.branch for new Codex tasks; never infer an active branch from chat memory or a retired branch.
branchSelectionContract.exactHeadSource: The referenced live pull request head is authoritative; frozen baselines are explicit and must not be confused with active development.

phasePlan.objective: Finish profile-safe dedicated ArmBand, Belt and HeadBand identities, slots, filters, routing and recovery without regressing proven container runtime.
phasePlan.acceptance: Identity manifest, ownership-scoped recovery, exact slots 15/16, filters, presentation and routing pass deterministic source/build/package/performance validation.

phasePlan.objective: Complete pickup, equip/remove, contents, persistence, native window/layout and fast-access lifecycle for all intended wearables.
phasePlan.acceptance: Lifecycle behavior is coherent and regression-covered with no unbounded polling, scene scans, global UI mutation, freezes or measurable idle cost.

phasePlan.objective: Harden compatibility, localization, install layout, package identity and profile-safe update/disable/uninstall recovery.
phasePlan.acceptance: All feasible automated regressions and exact-head packaging are green with frozen identities and no unresolved load/save or performance defect.

phasePlan.objective: Produce one coherent exact-head SPT 4.1.3 release candidate covering the complete product.
phasePlan.acceptance: The worker directly gives the user one GitHub-artifact runtime handoff with a short complete PASS/FAIL checklist after all automated work is exhausted.

phasePlan.objective: Remediate RC failures or deliberately promote the exact passing candidate.
phasePlan.acceptance: The batched runtime gate passes, the proven package is published, integration is verified and temporary work is cleaned up.

stableAcceptance: ArmBand, Belt and HeadBand use exact intended identities and slots
profile-safe update, disable, uninstall and downgrade
correct EN/RU presentation, pickup, lifecycle and persistence
no unbounded polling, scene scans, freezes or global UI mutation
one exact-head release candidate passes the batched SPT 4.1.3 runtime gate

phasePlan.objective: Fix the physical quest lifecycle so eligible quests remain offered until explicit Accept, objectives reach finish-ready without auto-Success, explicit Complete is required, and native success dialogue/reward delivery occurs exactly once.
phasePlan.acceptance: Source and automated evidence support the native manual lifecycle and one exact-head candidate is ready for the coherent campaign runtime gate; AllQuestsCheckmarks remains ruled out as root cause absent new contrary evidence.

phasePlan.objective: Prove the current 31-quest / 11-offer campaign as one coherent playable baseline with native lifecycle, rewards, success message/mail, questassort unlock and restart persistence.
phasePlan.acceptance: One batched physical milestone proves Offered -> explicit Accept -> Started -> progress -> AvailableForFinish -> explicit Complete -> Success -> reward/message -> unlock -> persistence with no duplicates.

phasePlan.objective: Materialize the prepared post-0.1.0 operation wave into actual runtime gameplay in bounded player-visible slices.
phasePlan.acceptance: Approved operations exist as real runtime quests with objectives, EN/RU copy, rewards, progression and deterministic validation; manifest-only research is not product completion.

phasePlan.objective: Consume approved QuestManiac/Andrudis/Natalya research only as curated rewritten source material for existing Admiral operations.
phasePlan.acceptance: No second trader, duplicate campaign or unnecessary dependency is introduced; only distinct approved concepts improve Admiral.

phasePlan.objective: Add bounded relationship progression and finite specialist stock after lifecycle and campaign foundations are stable.
phasePlan.acceptance: Relationship/storefront progression is finite, authored, Economy Admiral-compatible and does not create a second economy engine.

phasePlan.objective: Produce and deliberately promote one exact-head install-ready SPT 4.1.5 Admiral Trader release candidate after the expanded product is complete.
phasePlan.acceptance: One final batched runtime gate passes, the proven artifact is published, integration is verified and temporary work is cleaned up.

stableAcceptance: native button-driven quest lifecycle uses explicit Accept and explicit Complete
success dialogue/mail and authored XP/standing/RUB/item rewards deliver exactly once
questassort success unlocks appear only after Success and persist after restart
current 31-quest / 11-offer baseline remains coherent before expansion
approved post-0.1.0 operations become real runtime gameplay rather than manifest-only planning
relationship/storefront progression remains finite and Economy Admiral-compatible
one exact-head SPT 4.1.5 release candidate passes the final batched runtime gate
ruledOutHypotheses: AllQuestsCheckmarks as root cause of the auto-accept/auto-turn-in lifecycle defect, based on user physical A/B test with the mod disabled

phasePlan.objective: Complete provenance-safe bounded grouped item-reward normalization.
phasePlan.acceptance: Integrated evidence in PR #222 remains green and protected by regression coverage.

phasePlan.objective: Observe final DB acquisition pressure and bounded effective-acquisition paths without mutation.
phasePlan.acceptance: Integrated evidence in PR #226 remains deterministic, bounded, attributable and explicit about Unknown channels.

phasePlan.objective: Define separately inspectable fail-closed health and anti-overcorrection invariants.
phasePlan.acceptance: Integrated evidence in PR #226 preserves Pass/Fail/Unknown reasoning and blocks action on missing or conflicting evidence.

phasePlan.objective: Consume the maintained Admiral Trader explicit contract without inference or a second economy engine.
phasePlan.acceptance: Identity/schema/classes/gates/finite stock semantics validate explicitly; absent or incompatible evidence fails closed and does not authorize mutation.

phasePlan.objective: Activate only bounded Economy Beta policies justified by completed provenance, pressure, health and compatibility evidence.
phasePlan.acceptance: Off/Audit remain safe; Enforce is transactional, idempotent, pristine-protecting, bounded and fail-closed with deterministic preview/evidence.

phasePlan.objective: Produce one complete exact-head Economy Beta release candidate.
phasePlan.acceptance: The worker directly gives the user one GitHub-artifact SPT 4.1.3 runtime handoff after all automated enforcement and compatibility work is complete.

honest fail-closed source-pressure and health evidence
maintained Trader compatibility without inferred intent

phasePlan.objective: Stabilize Admiral Tactical HUD 1.13.3 RC2 without adding post-RC functionality: reliable Compact/status/body/self icons, independent Full Census, clean short weapon-text kill feed, deterministic lifecycle and package.
phasePlan.acceptance: Exact-head CI/package are green, no residual weapon-icon contract remains, and one batched physical SPT smoke proves Compact icons, fallback assets, Full Census, population, weapon-text kill feed, raid/menu lifecycle and clean logs.

phasePlan.objective: Simplify the accepted HUD architecture using typed EFT APIs where proven stable, reflection only for compatibility/optional integrations, unified world/player lifecycle, centralized icon/font/resources and removal of dead legacy paths.
phasePlan.acceptance: Accepted M1 behavior is unchanged while complexity and redundant compatibility machinery are reduced; deterministic validation stays green with no new global scans or permanent polling.

phasePlan.objective: Consolidate Compact and Full Census as two coherent population presentations using approved BotCensus-derived classification, glyph/resource, Fika observed-AI and bounded recount patterns.
phasePlan.acceptance: Population classes/counts and both presentations are coherent and independently controllable, use one bounded data model, preserve MIT attribution and introduce no duplicate always-on counting engine.

phasePlan.objective: Improve the status HUD with approved CompactHUD-derived typed status access, screen-aware BattleUI/Hideout visibility, optional total health and immediately usable Tactical Vest + Pockets grenade count.
phasePlan.acceptance: Status remains compact and Tarkov-appropriate, grenade count excludes backpack/secure container, inventory/menu hiding is correct and update cadence is bounded.

phasePlan.objective: Unify per-module scale/gap, horizontal/vertical layout, screen clamping, drag/edit frame, save/reset positioning and safe cursor lock/visibility restore.
phasePlan.acceptance: Editing is obvious, reversible and persistent, normal gameplay has no edit-mode overhead and all modules remain visually coherent.

phasePlan.objective: Minimize HUD runtime cost with separated status/population/kill cadences, cached immutable render data, reused scratch/UI objects and disabled-section zero/low-work behavior.
phasePlan.acceptance: Guarded hot paths contain no recurring avoidable allocations/global scans/reflection, hidden sections do no unnecessary work, and no FPS/frametime/stutter regression is introduced.

phasePlan.objective: Produce and deliberately promote one final install-ready Admiral Tactical HUD package after all approved milestones are complete.
phasePlan.acceptance: Canonical naming/install paths, EN/RU terminology, third-party attribution and package cleanup are correct; one final exact-head physical runtime gate passes; merge/publication/main verification and branch cleanup succeed.
